overview.description: The ETRACS Quarterly Pay 1.5X Leveraged Alerian MLP Index ETN (MLPR) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Alerian MLP index. The fund provides quarterly 1.5x leveraged exposure to a market-cap-weighted index of 50 publicly traded energy MLPs. MLPR was launched on Jun 2, 2020 and is issued by ETRACS.
